title: Bora Employer Pipeline Evidence Match Record
description: Structured mapping from one job requirement to Evidence_ID and/or Claim_ID provenance with a locked match result. Positive matches require provenance. Partial transfer must remain explicit.

transfer_note.description: Explicit transfer boundary when result is PARTIAL. Null otherwise.

evaluation_path.description: ALTERNATIVE_QUALIFICATION_BRANCH_REPRESENTATION_V1: additive, stable, machine-readable identification of which deterministic evaluation path produced this result -- Match truth, never Employer truth. A closed V1 enumeration of currently-real paths only, not a general ontology. Human-readable `explanation` text must never control consequential (qualification-gate) logic; this field is the only machine-readable signal consumers may use for that purpose. Null/absent for match records not produced by one of the enumerated paths (e.g. synthetic/test-constructed records) -- consumers must treat a missing/unrecognized value as UNRESOLVED, never as an authoritative negative.
